title: I ran 3 Claude Code architecture diagram tools on my repo. Here's what each one got right
why_read: A hands-on comparison of three real Claude Code plugins for auto-generating architecture diagrams, tested against an actual multi-repo project.
analysis: The author ran three different open-source tools that use Claude Code to turn a real codebase into architecture diagrams or knowledge graphs, then compared their outputs, time cost, and dollar cost. This is a genuinely practical piece for engineers evaluating AI-assisted codebase documentation and understanding tools rather than abstract discussion. It includes concrete details like setup time, failed runs, and actual dollar costs, which is useful real-world signal often missing from vendor blog posts. The comparison format makes it easy to judge trade-offs between competing tools for a common, relatable engineering need.
